warmup.name: Leg Kicks
warmup.description: A dynamic kick where you alternately swing each leg forward and back to open up the hips and warm the muscles. Stand tall with hands on hips or out to the sides, kick one leg forward then sweep it back while keeping the standing leg stable and core braced. Benefits: loosens the hip flexors and hamstrings, raises body temperature, and improves balance and coordination before a workout.

Benefits: warms up the legs and glutes, activates the core, and improves hip mobility and coordination.
